baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ج و ب forms at words 2 and 7 oppose response to nonresponse, then word 18 introduces attempted ransom.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same response construction governs both groups, but only the first enters a relation with their Lord and receives the good. The second cannot replace that missing relation with a transfer of possessions; response and ransom are deliberately non-equivalent operations.

activation_trace.role: Reply and answering supply the reciprocal act whose presence or absence divides the two outcomes.
Lordship and ownership make the response relational and expose the futility of paying the owner with owned things.
Beneficent good supplies an outcome received within the responsive relation, not a commodity bought afterward.
Substitution by a saving payment supplies the failed rival mechanism to response.

changed_reading.before: The ayah assigns reward for obedience and punishment for disobedience.
changed_reading.after: The ayah contrasts a reciprocal answer that cannot be purchased with a late attempt to substitute owned quantity for an unanswered relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 14-18 maximize the proposed payment as all the earth plus its equal, while word 23 names the account.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hypothetical assembles completeness, duplication, and substitution, then declares the account bad. The sufficiency branch of ح س ب lets سوء الحساب mean not only severe reckoning but an account against which even a doubled total proves radically insufficient.

activation_trace.role: The whole lower realm supplies the maximal spatial extent of the imagined asset base.
Wholeness without loss supplies explicit completeness rather than merely a large amount.
An equal counterpart doubles the supposedly complete total.
A saving substitute turns the doubled total into a proposed settlement.
Sufficiency and adequacy recast the bad account as a deficit no quantity can cover.

changed_reading.before: All earthly wealth, even doubled, would not be accepted as ransom.
changed_reading.after: The ayah runs a limit test on quantity: complete possession, duplication, and substitution still yield an account defined by non-sufficiency.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 22-27 move without a new subject from bad account to refuge, Hell, blame, and bed.
baseline_models.mechanism: The legal register of account is converted into spatial and material emplacement. Reckoning is not followed by an unrelated penalty; it resolves into where the nonresponders gather, what receives them, and what has been prepared as their resting surface.

activation_trace.role: Badness and defect qualify the account and begin the descent from judgment into condition.
Counting and reckoning supply the adjudicative stage that is translated into habitat.
Gathering into a shelter turns judgment into an assigned destination.
The formal word of blame evaluates the final emplacement rather than adding a separate event.
Preparation and leveling make the bed the completed material form of the preceding account.

changed_reading.before: A bad reckoning is followed by Hell as punishment.
changed_reading.after: The reckoning materializes as an anti-home: account, gathering-place, and prepared bed are stages of one terminal emplacement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The response is explicitly to their رب at word 3 and its outcome is الحسنى at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The تربـية and growth branches around ر ب ب/ر ب و activate the Lord not only as commander but as one who brings something to completion by stages. The utmost-good branch of ح س ن then makes الحسنى the ripened limit of that formation rather than an arbitrary prize.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion supply a staged formative relation behind Lordship.
Growth through nourishment preserves the non-dominant mapped root as a live developmental image.
The utmost limit or full effort casts الحسنى as the culminating good of that formation.

changed_reading.before: Their Lord grants responders the best reward.
changed_reading.after: Responding admits them into an ongoing formative relation whose matured limit is الحسنى.

context_deltas.mechanism: 13:6 names a demand that accelerates evil ahead of good, while 13:18 restores the order الحسنى then سوء الحساب. Response can therefore be read as receptivity to the offered good, whereas nonresponse includes an inverted appetite that demands harmful proof first.

activation_trace.role: Hastening and advancing supply the temporal pressure that pushes evil out of order.
Badness supplies the demanded object that is perversely pulled forward.
Precedence explicitly orders one outcome ahead of another and makes reversal diagnostic.
Goodness supplies the displaced positive term that 13:18 restores to first position.
Covering the fault and protecting its bearer blocks a simplistic immediate-retaliation mechanism.
The focus ayah places the good outcome first and supplies the corrected order.

structural_cues: 13:6 says السيئة قبل الحسنة, whereas 13:18 presents الحسنى before سوء الحساب; 13:6 also holds forgiveness and severe consequence together.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the reversed word order and delayed forgiveness; I infer that response includes accepting the proper order of address and outcome. A live alternative is that 13:6 and 13:18 only contrast impatience with final judgment.

changed_reading.before: The two groups simply receive opposite final outcomes.
changed_reading.after: The division also diagnoses temporal desire: responders receive good, while nonresponders have already shown an urge to drag evil ahead of good as proof.

context_deltas.mechanism: 13:14 renders nonresponse as a broken relay: a call is issued, hands extend toward water, but water does not reach the mouth. That material non-arrival sharpens 13:18: positive response completes a reciprocal circuit, while the later ransom is a second imagined transfer that also cannot arrive at its goal.

activation_trace.role: Calling and drawing by speech supply the initiating signal of the relay.
Answering supplies the explicitly failed reciprocal link that the focus repeats.
Extending the hand materializes an offered but ineffective reach.
The outstretched palm supplies a posture of request without successful receipt.
Literal water supplies the desired medium that remains physically separated from the requester.
Arrival at a goal supplies the repeatedly negated completion condition.
The proposed saving transfer becomes a second failed attempt to bridge nonresponse.

structural_cues: 13:14 orders call, nonresponse, extended palms, water, mouth, and failed arrival; 13:18 repeats the response polarity before introducing payment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a verbal failure embodied as failed reaching; I carry that transfer logic into the focus ransom. The alternative is to keep the water simile limited to false invocation and treat ransom as a separate legal image.

changed_reading.before: Responders obey, and nonresponders later offer an unacceptable ransom.
changed_reading.after: Response is successful relational arrival; nonresponse and ransom are two versions of a transfer that never reaches its intended endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: 13:15 places everything in the heavens and earth, willingly or unwillingly, inside a field of prostration. Thus 13:18's nonresponders are not outside all response; they refuse willing answer while their bodies, world, and shadows remain structurally submitted. Their fantasy of owning all earth for ransom is also compromised because the proposed asset already answers to the same Lord.

activation_trace.role: Lowering and submission supply the universal responsive field beneath deliberate answer.
The lower realm itself is included among the submitting entities later imagined as property.
Willing compliance supplies the mode that most closely matches positive response.
Being carried into what is disliked supplies submission without willing answer.
The shadow of a standing body supplies an involuntary responder attached to each person.
Ransom exposes the impossible attempt to transfer an already-submitted world as independent property.

structural_cues: 13:15 totalizes heavens and earth, contrasts willing and unwilling modes, and adds shadows at recurring times.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal prostration and the focus's hypothetical possession of all earth; I infer that earth cannot function as an external bargaining asset. The alternative is that 13:15 only establishes sovereignty without qualifying the ransom image.

changed_reading.before: Some people respond and others simply do not.
changed_reading.after: The true contrast is willing relational response versus refusal within unavoidable submission, and the earth offered as ransom is already inside that submission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding water-and-fire process sorts contents by capacity, truth, benefit, and persistence: rising foam is discarded while useful matter remains in earth. 13:18 then reads less like an isolated verdict and more like the disclosed result of an assay. Responsive capacity retains benefit; spectacular volume, even all earth doubled, cannot ransom what proves foam-like or nonpersistent.

activation_trace.role: Flowing runoff supplies the transport process through which contents are exposed and sorted.
A valley as the course of floodwater supplies differentiated receiving capacity.
A measure that reaches a thing's limit constrains each channel independently of apparent total volume.
Floating foam supplies conspicuous excess that rises yet has no durable efficacy.
Truth as stable correspondence supplies the criterion that survives the assay.
Loss of truth and stability supplies the failure mode of what disappears.
Benefit as the opposite of harm supplies the positive value that survives sorting.
Remaining with patient stability supplies the positive material result of the sorting process.
Soft productive earth supplies the receiving place in which useful matter remains.
The focus's complete total becomes a deliberate stress test showing that volume is not persistence.

structural_cues: 13:17 immediately precedes the focus and repeats parallel water and smelting processes before contrasting disappearance with remaining in earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured channels, floating residue, stable truth, and remaining benefit; I infer a process-to-verdict arrow into 13:18. The live alternative is that the parable illustrates truth and falsehood generally without modeling the two response groups materially.

changed_reading.before: The ayah announces two externally assigned destinies.
changed_reading.after: The destinies are also assay results: response is capacity that receives and retains benefit, while amassed but unstable excess cannot become saving value.

context_deltas.mechanism: 13:20-25 unfolds the two respondent classes as opposed network operations. The first complete and preserve covenant, join what is to be joined, and place good against evil; the second unbind covenant and cut connection. استجابوا therefore expands from a verbal answer into sustained connective conduct, and الحسنى becomes an active good before it is an outcome.

activation_trace.role: Answering supplies the compact focus act that the following conduct unpacks.
Completion without deficiency turns response into maintained fulfillment.
A protected covenant supplies the relation that continued response preserves.
Joining one thing to another supplies the constructive social operation of response.
Doing beneficent good makes الحسنى operative as a force placed against evil.
Undoing what was bound supplies the inverse operation of nonresponse.
Severing a connection supplies the social topology produced by refusal.

structural_cues: 13:22 root د ر ء at word 13 has no branch inventory, so only its construction, placing الحسنة against السيئة, supplies the reversal cue.
13:20-25 repeats والذين and mirrors fulfillment/joining against unbinding/cutting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored relational operations after the focus; I infer that they unpack the functional content of response and nonresponse. A live alternative is that they list consequences of belief rather than define the response mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Response is a single act of assent that earns good.
changed_reading.after: Response is a maintained topology of fulfilling, joining, and answering evil with enacted good; nonresponse materializes as unbinding and severance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence gives the positive counterpart to the focus's evil refuge and bed: entry through every gate, greeting of safety, hearts settling through remembrance, and حسن مآب. The good is therefore simultaneously future habitation, relational welcome, and a present settling of the inner place.

activation_trace.role: Gathering into refuge supplies the negative spatial endpoint that the later return reverses.
Entering an interior supplies actual inhabitation rather than abstract reward.
A doorway supplies repeated access and welcome into the good endpoint.
Safety from harm supplies the social and affective quality of the inhabited outcome.
Stillness and tranquility supply a present inward analogue of settled abode.
Recollection that keeps something present supplies the process by which the heart settles.
Goodness explicitly qualifies the return and binds the later home back to الحسنى.
Return to a home supplies the positive counterpart to the focus's evil refuge.

structural_cues: 13:23-24 moves through entry, doors, and greeting; 13:28 repeats heart-settling twice; 13:29 closes with حسن مآب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spatial entry, safety, repeated tranquility, and good return; I infer one habitation mechanism spanning present heart and final abode. The alternative keeps inward tranquility and eschatological home as parallel but separate benefits.

changed_reading.before: الحسنى is an unspecified reward opposite Hell.
changed_reading.after: الحسنى is a settled return already anticipated in a heart that finds rest, then completed as entered, welcomed, safe habitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: 13:39-41 places erasure and establishment with God, assigns the account to the divine side, depicts earth itself being diminished at its edges, and calls the account swift. The focus's proposed ransom is therefore not merely too small: both the ledger and the supposedly total asset are under the authority of the one reckoning.

activation_trace.role: Erasure of an effect supplies sovereign control over what remains on the ledger.
Fixity and continuance supply the complementary authority to establish what endures.
Reckoning explicitly assigned to the divine side identifies who controls the account.
The same lower realm imagined as total ransom becomes the object being acted upon.
Loss of part of a thing makes the proposed total asset visibly unstable.
Edges and limits locate where the apparently complete earth is reduced.
Speed removes the temporal space in which a late compensating transfer might be imagined.
The focus's failed sufficiency is explained by control of both valuation and asset.

structural_cues: 13:40 contrasts the messenger's duty with وعلينا الحساب; 13:41 says no one can reverse the judgment before naming swift account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine erasure/establishment, ownership of account, and diminishing earth; I infer that the ransom fails because payer, asset, and ledger are not independent. The alternative treats these as separate sovereignty statements rather than an explanation of 13:18's failed payment.

changed_reading.before: The ransom fails because its amount is inadequate to the sentence.
changed_reading.after: The ransom fails more fundamentally because the reckoner controls valuation, persistence, and the earth offered as payment; there is no external asset from which to bargain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates branch-distant cutting, opening, and disclosure images rather than the ordinary reply branch. It remains anchored in both ج و ب forms and gains coherence from 13:14's failed water-reaching scene. Downstream prose should present it only as a material overlay on response, not as an etymological replacement for استجاب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opposed ج و ب forms at words 2 and 7 can carry an open-channel versus closed-channel contrast.

activation_trace.role: A penetrating cut supplies the act that makes passage through resistant material.
An opening or gap supplies a receptive interior through which an answer can arrive.
Disclosure and clearing supply what becomes visible when the channel opens.
Water supplies the material that would move through a receptive channel but remains apart.
Failed arrival supplies the observable consequence of a channel that never opens.

changed_reading.before: Response is an affirmative verbal act.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, response opens a passage through which address, disclosure, and benefit arrive; refusal leaves the circuit materially closed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses two branches of م ث ل: quantitative equivalence and punitive exemplarity. It remains anchored in focus word 16 and the exact same root at 13:6. Downstream prose should mark it as lexical resonance or grim wordplay, not claim that ومثله syntactically means punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The proposed ومثله at word 16 names an equal counterpart inside the failed ransom.

activation_trace.role: Equivalence supplies the literal doubling by which the nonresponders try to enlarge payment.
Exemplary punishment supplies the latent reversal from offering an equal to being made a warning.
Earlier punitive examples make the non-quantitative branch locally active before the focus.
The failed saving substitute supplies the pivot on which equivalence turns into exemplarity.

changed_reading.before: They would add an equal amount to all the earth to maximize ransom.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the offered 'equal' carries the shadow of the earlier exemplary punishments: failed equivalence reverses into the payer becoming an example.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins the nurture branch of رب with the infant-bed branch of مهد inside a Hell scene. It remains anchored at the ayah's two endpoints, their Lord and their bed, and preserves the explicit good/bad polarity. Downstream prose should call it a counter-image of formation, not imply that المهاد loses its ordinary bed sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ayah begins its positive side with لربهم and closes the negative side with بئس المهاد.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion supply the positive formative relation offered to responders.
Growth by nourishment keeps the split-root developmental image active.
An infant's prepared cradle supplies the terminal counter-image to divine nurture.
Explicit blame marks the cradle image as a perverse formation rather than comfort.

changed_reading.before: Responders receive good, while Hell is the nonresponders' terrible bed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the endpoints form a counter-nursery: willing response enters the Lord's maturing care, while refusal culminates in a blamed cradle that fixes rather than grows its occupant.

strongest_changes: 13:14 turns response into successful arrival and makes ransom a second failed transfer.
13:17 turns the verdict into a material assay of capacity, persistence, and benefit rather than quantity.
13:20-25 unfolds response as fulfilling and joining, while nonresponse becomes unbinding and cutting.
13:39-41 show that the reckoner controls both the account and the earth imagined as payment.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses several mechanisms without forcing a single winner: reciprocal answer versus substitution, totality versus sufficiency, assay versus accumulation, connection versus severance, and good return versus anti-home. Its strangest live branch resonances recast response as an aperture, an offered equal as punitive exemplarity, and the evil bed as a counter-image to the Lord's nurture.
remaining_uncertainties: The hydraulic transfer model is strongly sequenced but the extension from failed reaching to failed ransom remains reader-supplied.
The universal-submission model may establish sovereignty without directly denying hypothetical possession.
The aperture, equivalence/exemplar, and counter-nursery readings are intentionally branch-distant and should remain qualified rather than lexicalized.
